stem:
Which of the following statements about health is correct ( )
A. Ravi is healthy because no disease has been found in his body
B. Meena is free from illness but feels lonely and cannot sleep well, so she is fully healthy
C. A person is healthy only when physical, mental, and social well-being are all present, not merely when disease is absent
D. Arjun has strong muscles and plays cricket daily, so he must be healthy even if he is often worried and has no friends

options.text: Ravi is healthy because no disease has been found in his body
Meena is free from illness but feels lonely and cannot sleep well, so she is fully healthy
A person is healthy only when physical, mental, and social well-being are all present, not merely when disease is absent
Arjun has strong muscles and plays cricket daily, so he must be healthy even if he is often worried and has no friends

teacher.key_rationale: Health means complete physical, mental, and social well-being, not just the absence of disease. Options A, B, and D each treat freedom from disease or physical fitness alone as proof of health while ignoring mental or social well-being, so they are wrong. Only C states the full definition, so C is the key.
